note: SNAPSHOT. Every number below was correct on catalog_version and is stale the moment a vendor changes a price or ships a model. Regenerating this file is the REQ-CAT-06 ritual, and two fields must be diffed per model on every regeneration because they change the request body: thinking_level_map (REQ-PROV-15 -- an entry that silently disappears turns a clamped request into a 400, and an entry that silently appears sends a level the model does not know) and cost, including the vendor of fallback-served rows (REQ-PROV-05.5 -- dropping it bills a fallback at the wrong rate, silently). Everything else in a row is a capability hint the clamp and the budget gate can survive being slightly wrong about. This catalog is NOT an allowlist: an unknown id under a known vendor clones that vendor's default_model row (REQ-CAT-03), so a model released after this snapshot works without an SDK release.

claude-opus-4-5.name: Claude Opus 4.5
claude-opus-4-5.note: Effort-style reasoning control: the wire value is the effort token. 'minimal' is present-and-null because this row's effort ladder starts at 'low' -- see REQ-PROV-15 and ruling P-28: present-null and absent are the SAME at runtime, and the distinction exists only so the REQ-CAT-06 diff can tell 'we checked, it is unsupported' from 'we never looked'. xhigh and max are absent: they are opt-in. Cache write is the 5-minute rate (1.25x input); cache read is 0.1x input.

claude-sonnet-4-5.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
claude-sonnet-4-5.note: Budget-style reasoning control: the wire value is a thinking token budget, not an effort token, which is why the map is deliberately opaque to everything above the adapter. 1024 is the vendor minimum. A 1M-token context window exists behind a beta header at premium pricing; this row is the un-beta'd shape, because sending max_tokens sized for 1M against a 200k request is the exact REQ-CAT-04 failure. Vendor default_model: the clone template for unknown anthropic ids.

claude-haiku-4-5.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
claude-haiku-4-5.note: Same budget-style control as sonnet-4-5 at the small-model price point.

gpt-4o.name: GPT-4o
gpt-4o.note: No thinking_level_map at all: absent means unsupported (REQ-PROV-15), and ClampThinkingLevel therefore reports 'omit the key' rather than sending a level this model would 400 on. Cache write is free on this vendor; cache read is half of input. Vendor default_model: the clone template for unknown openai ids.

o3.name: o3
o3.note: 'off' is present-and-null: this model cannot be asked not to reason, and recording that explicitly is what makes the REQ-CAT-06 diff able to distinguish a checked fact from an unfilled row. It changes nothing at runtime (ruling P-28). 'minimal', 'xhigh' and 'max' are absent, so requesting max clamps DOWN to high -- REQ-PROV-15's own worked example. max_tokens_field is max_completion_tokens and temperature is rejected: that is what compat exists for, and a sibling clone of this row would inherit both.
